title: Goal-Oriented Training Data Organization (GTDO): From Training Data Organization to Runtime Computational Organization
description: Goal-Oriented Training Data Organization (GTDO) proposes a structural approach to AI computation in which training data are organized according to future computational goals rather than statistical similarity alone. GTDO transforms training data organization into computational organization through Goal Functions, Brain Units, Dispatch Trees, Calling Graphs, Call Paths, localized Runtime optimization, and Structural Security Infrastructure. The repository establishes an organizational foundation for trustworthy Runtime AI and complements the broader Structural Runtime AI ecosystem, including SRAI, FTRIA, RI, SRMS, and Information Job Shop (IJS).
